changeSet.author: muw-ophthalmology

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM study_item_binding WHERE binding_key LIKE 'namd.flags.%' AND item_oid IN ('NAMD_OD_NEW_HEMORRHAGE', 'NAMD_OS_NEW_HEMORRHAGE', 'NAMD_OD_BCVA_LOSS_NAMD_ATTRIBUTED', 'NAMD_OS_BCVA_LOSS_NAMD_ATTRIBUTED') ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

changeSet.comment: nAMD flag bindings: item names become the items' OIDs.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE study_item_binding SET item_oid = 'I_' || item_oid WHERE binding_key LIKE 'namd.flags.%' AND item_oid IN ('NAMD_OD_NEW_HEMORRHAGE', 'NAMD_OS_NEW_HEMORRHAGE', 'NAMD_OD_BCVA_LOSS_NAMD_ATTRIBUTED', 'NAMD_OS_BCVA_LOSS_NAMD_ATTRIBUTED');

rollback.sql: UPDATE study_item_binding SET item_oid = SUBSTRING(item_oid FROM 3) WHERE binding_key LIKE 'namd.flags.%' AND item_oid IN ('I_NAMD_OD_NEW_HEMORRHAGE', 'I_NAMD_OS_NEW_HEMORRHAGE', 'I_NAMD_OD_BCVA_LOSS_NAMD_ATTRIBUTED', 'I_NAMD_OS_BCVA_LOSS_NAMD_ATTRIBUTED');
